title: Revision R4 Master Experimental Artifacts Manifest

classical_seeds_summary.json.description: 10-seed evaluation of C2 tuned PoE, C2 tuned Gated Head, and C1 default PoE on N=56,534 held-out patients.

a1_quantum_seeds_summary.json.description: 10-seed evaluation of C1 default VQC and C2 tuned VQC, paired t-tests, seed-level TOST, and hierarchical bootstrap.

a2_selection_robustness.json.description: 36-config selection stability across 20 resampled dev splits, plus full 60 classical grid sensitivity analysis.

a3_class_analysis.json.description: Class-conditional DeltaNLL with 95% bootstrap CIs, macro-mean TOST failure, and vector scaling ablation.

domain_shift_analysis.json.description: Institutional transfer from MIMIC-CXR to CheXpert, angle-wrapping verification, and Fourier trigonometric baseline comparison.

m1_effective_order.json.description: Interaction-order energy spectrum excluding constant Z8 reference qubit across 10 C1b seeds and confirmatory circuit.

m2_completeness.json.description: Classical order-1 and order-2 trigonometric Fourier surrogates and polynomial linear regression on N=56,534 test patients.

ckd_protocol_grid.json.description: 90-protocol grid for Chronic Kidney Disease literature replication across scalers, cross-validation schemes, and models.
